# Baseball Prospectus

> > Baseball Prospectus provides in-depth sabermetric analysis, statistical research, and expert commentary on Major League Baseball teams, players, and transactions.

Founded as a pioneering sabermetrics publication, Baseball Prospectus offers analytical coverage of MLB through statistical modeling, prospect evaluation, fantasy baseball guidance, and transaction analysis. The site features work examining teams like the Cubs, Red Sox, Yankees, and Braves using advanced metrics and the principles established by Bill James.

## Key Topics

- Sabermetrics
- Transaction Analysis
- Fantasy Baseball
- Statistical Modeling
- Pythagorean Theorem (Bill James)
- Hall of Fame Analysis
- Playoff Predictions
- Roster Moves
- Player Evaluation
- Draft Strategy
- MLB Teams (Cubs, Orioles, Red Sox, Yankees, Braves, Mets)
- Relief Pitchers
- Prospect Analysis
- Baseball Commentary
